home.desc: Established in 2021, EBER Group serves as a leading organization overseeing four top-performing chemical manufacturing companies in Indonesia. With a focus on quality, sustainability, and innovation, we are committed to delivering material solutions that support the growth of various industries.
home.specialty_section_desc: Since 2021, EBER Group has overseen four of Indonesia’s leading chemical manufacturing companies. Backed by decades of experience and a commitment to innovation, we deliver material solutions that promote sustainable growth in the petrochemical industry.

1.title: Advanced Materials
1.desc: Specializing in high-performance chemical manufacturing and processing.

2.title: Innovation Focus
2.desc: Focused on sustainable chemical production and innovation.

3.title: Sustainability
3.desc: Providing environmentally friendly solvent and chemical solutions

4.title: Expert Team
4.desc: A trusted producer of petrochemical products and solutions, supported by a team of experienced professionals.

home.custom_product_section_desc: EBER Group’s expertise in specialty materials is supported by a strong in-house R&D team, enabling us to provide innovative solutions that improve products and processes in the infrastructure, construction, automotive, environmental, and manufacturing sectors.
home.subsidiaries_section_desc: As an integrated chemical group, EBER Group oversees four leading manufacturing companies strategically located across Indonesia. Each subsidiary has its own specialization, collectively strengthening EBER Group’s position as a key player in the national petrochemical industry.

1.title: PT Eternal Buana Chemical Industries
1.desc: based in Cikupa, Banten, is a producer of resins and specialty chemicals with a production capacity of up to 70,000 MT per year. Its product lines include paper chemicals, alkyd acrylic amino resins, unsaturated polyester resins, and synthetic latex resins.

2.title: PT Eterindo Nusa Graha
2.desc: located in Gresik, East Java, has a production capacity of 51,000 MT per year. The company focuses on plasticizers, resins, and specialty chemicals applied across various industries, including paper, automotive, and synthetic materials.

3.title: PT Petrowidada
3.desc: based in Gresik, is a leading domestic producer of phthalic anhydride with a production capacity of 70,000 MT per year. This product serves as an essential component in various petrochemical applications, particularly for the resin and plastics industries.

4.title: PT Mega Prima Solvindo
4.desc: headquartered in Cilegon, Banten, produces n-Butyl Acetate with a capacity of 20,000 MT per year. As a key chemical, this product is widely used in the coatings, paint, and adhesive industries.

home.innovation_section_desc: At EBER Group, we are committed to continuously pushing the boundaries of the petrochemical industry. With state-of-the-art research facilities and a dedicated team of scientists and engineers, we develop innovative solutions that address customer needs while staying aligned with global market dynamics.

1.title: Research & Development
1.desc: Continuous investment in R&D to create advanced materials and innovative chemical solutions.

2.title: Digital Transformation
2.desc: Optimizing production and operations through cutting-edge technology.

3.title: Sustainable Solutions
3.desc: Developing eco-friendly products and processes to minimize environmental impact.

4.title: Collaborative Innovation
4.desc: Partnering with industry leaders and research institutions to drive breakthrough innovations.

home.top_product_section_desc: Discover our selection of top-quality products designed to deliver reliability, performance, and long-lasting value across various applications.

about_us.corporate_section_desc: At EBER Group, we are committed to maintaining the highest standards of corporate governance, ensuring transparency, accountability, and ethical business practices across all our operations.

consent.desc_p3: EBER Petrochemical will retain my personal data for a period of sixty (60) calendar days from the date of submission. Upon the expiration of this period, the data will be permanently deleted from the company’s system in accordance with its data protection policy.
